question: Which of the following statements about the ‘Gotra’ practice in ancient India is true?

options.text: Each gotra was named after a famous king.
Women retained their father’s gotra after marriage.
Men and women were expected to marry within the same gotra.
People belonging to the same gotra were regarded as descendants of the person after whom the gotra was named.

solution:
The correct answer is__** People belonging to the same gotra were regarded as descendants of the person after whom the gotra was named.**__
